methodology: Automotive FCFF DCF plus separately valued finance and other businesses; normalized-EPS PER cross-check; residual income model.

sotp_bridge.note: These are analyst bridge inputs, not company guidance. They require revalidation against Hyundai Motor's detailed quarterly and annual financial statements. Consolidated financial-service debt is not subtracted as automotive net debt.

per.note: Applied PER is an analyst cross-check input, not a peer-average multiple or company guidance. It is set below the DCF-implied multiple to reflect auto cyclicality, CAPEX and finance-service volatility.

share_count.note: Economic share count is an analyst input and must be reconciled to treasury shares and any equity-linked securities at each results update.

source_policy: Actual financial results and company guidance are cited in actuals_and_sources.json. Forecast, SOTP bridge, discount rates and valuation outputs are analyst estimates.
